results.condition: Build and verify the Luna Lantern Dash playable browser game in the repository's expected app structure, including responsive canvas UI, controls, HUD, restart, win/lose states, and committed implementation.
results.evidence:
Summary: Built, critiqued, remediated, browser-verified, committed, and pushed Luna Lantern Dash.
Criterion: Playable responsive 2D canvas game with lantern controls, shards, clouds, timer, HUD, restart, and win/lose states | Evidence: project/index.html, project/styles.css, and project/game.js implement the complete static game; Final verifier confirmed keyboard movement, pointer movement, 10 shard collection, cloud collision, timer/HUD, win/lose overlays, and reset controls
Criterion: Required child orchestration and critique loop | Evidence: Builder session ses_fb9c31fe5ffeXZNdaMqIyVfoTR returned implementation report; Critic session ses_fb9c31fc0ffeYGzHakzMI6Y3Sv returned concrete gap: static arena versus forward journey; Remediation added continuous star parallax while preserving requested four-direction controls; Final verifier session ses_fb9bc91e7ffe0k0UHymGNMRuzO returned passing gameplay evidence
Criterion: Committed implementation and browser evidence | Evidence: Pushed commit cbf87a6 on branch opencode/33136514176; Screenshot committed at project/screenshots/final-luna-lantern-dash.png; node --check game.js and git diff --check passed; Chromium served and rendered the app at http://127.0.0.1:4173/
Check: node --check game.js | passed | exit 0
Check: git diff --check | passed | exit 0
Check: chromium --headless --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --window-size=1280,900 --screenshot=screenshots/final-luna-lantern-dash.png http://127.0.0.1:4173/ | passed | exit 0
Changed files: project/index.html, project/styles.css, project/game.js, project/screenshots/final-luna-lantern-dash.png
Known limitations: No full automated 60-second playthrough test suite in the minimal static repository.; Worker/session artifacts outside the project remain untracked and were not included.
